picks.excerpt: Meta is rolling out a mandatory v26 update that disables the camera on its Ray-Ban and Oakley smart glasses if the privacy LED is physically tampered with or destroyed, hardening the AI camera-glasses against privacy circumvention.
picks.rationale: Concrete new firmware policy hard-linking the privacy LED to camera function - a real consent/UX signal for wearable AI cameras, distinct from prior Meta cards (super-sensing, premium tier).

picks.excerpt: Ahead of the July 22 Unpacked, Samsung is expected to debut the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8 and new smartwatches with expanded Galaxy AI features spanning predictive, agentic and generative photo-editing tools.
picks.rationale: Timely full-event expectations roundup on the eve of the July 22 Unpacked; distinct from the earlier date-confirmation card (galaxy-z8) by centering the agentic/generative Galaxy AI feature set.

picks.excerpt: iRobot launched five new self-emptying Roomba robot vacuums under new owner Picea Robotics, led by the Roomba Max 775 with AI-driven navigation, a self-covering roller mop and a dock that washes mops with 165-degree water.
picks.rationale: iRobot's post-acquisition relaunch with AI navigation and novel self-cleaning mop hardware - a fresh, concrete product line distinct from prior Roborock review coverage.

picks.excerpt: BrainCo demonstrated a brain-controlled robot AI platform at Shanghai's 2026 World AI Conference: an EEG headset reads brain signals and decodes them into robot commands within 200 milliseconds, hands-free.
picks.rationale: Novel EEG-to-robot control demo with sub-200ms latency - a frontier hands-free interaction paradigm worth surfacing for future AI interface design.
